gloss: heating and cooling costs; air-conditioning expenses

definitions.gloss: heating and cooling costs; air-conditioning expenses
definitions.explanation: The cost of heating in winter and cooling in summer, usually as a household or building utility expense. Combines {冷房|れいぼう} (cooling) and {暖房|だんぼう} (heating) with {費|ひ} (expense).

examples.japanese: {冷暖房費|れいだんぼうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Save on heating and cooling costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{断熱|だんねつ}→断熱：06427_dannetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{冷暖房費|れいだんぼうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Insulation lowers heating and cooling costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{冷暖房費|れいだんぼうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧つく。
examples.english: Because this building is old, the heating and cooling costs run high.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{冷房|れいぼう}→冷房：01755_reibou⟧ (cooling) + ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧ (heating) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense).

- {冷暖房費|れいだんぼうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさむ: heating and cooling costs mount up
